article_title: Beyond AI Multiples: The Value in Boring Businesses
news_headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns: Live updates
post_text:
Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO on November 12, after revelations of two extramarital affairs, one involving a woman U.S. intelligence officials believe is a Chinese spy. CFO Colette Kress was named interim chief, the board launched a permanent successor search, and Nvidia's stock fell roughly 30% from its October all-time high, erasing close to $1.76 trillion in market cap.

The damage exposes a structural flaw in how markets valued Nvidia. At nearly $4 trillion, the stock had priced in almost nothing for founder-dependency risk. One person's exit, whatever the reason, doesn't wipe out that much value unless the multiple was doing work the fundamentals couldn't support alone.

WBR's "Beyond AI Multiples: The Value in Boring Businesses" laid this out before the fall. Capital sprinting toward AI at ~30x revenue tends to skip the risks that cash-generative, predictable businesses quietly don't carry. Nvidia's month is what those risks look like when they land. Read the full piece on our website.

#WBR #Nvidia
